## About SiMa.ai

SiMa.ai™ is the company enabling high performance machine learning to go green. Led by a team of industry experts, the company is committed to delivering the highest frames per second per watt solution in the market to its customers – accelerating the proliferation of high performance machine learning inference at very low power in embedded edge applications.

Founded in 2018by Krishna Rangasayee and Steven J. Rosston.
